resources.string: Termux is not installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play.
For your security, Pigkin only runs in the official F-Droid or Google Play build of Termux, and the Termux on this phone is neither. Reinstall Termux from F-Droid or Google Play.
Pigkin isn\'t allowed to run commands in Termux. In Pigkin\'s app info, go to Permissions → Additional permissions → Run commands in Termux environment → Allow, then retry.
Termux blocked Pigkin\'s commands. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Android blocked starting Termux in the background. Open Pigkin and retry.
Open Termux once and let it finish installing.
Node.js is missing in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Node.js can\'t run or is too old. Run `%1$s` in Termux, then retry.
Pigkin\'s Termux helper did not receive its token. Retry.
Pigkin\'s Termux helper exited with status %1$d before connecting.
Termux did not respond in time. Open Termux once, then retry.
The connection to Termux closed unexpectedly. Retry.
Termux stopped while starting Pigkin\'s helper. Retry.
Termux couldn\'t run Pigkin\'s helper. Retry.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed Pi, its sign-in and Pigkin\'s setup in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Pigkin isn\'t set up in Termux yet. Run the setup command in Termux.
Termux\'s Pigkin helper doesn\'t recognize this Pigkin. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Pigkin\'s helper isn\'t running in Termux. Open Termux, then switch back to Pigkin.
Another app is using the ports Pigkin\'s helper needs. Restart your phone, then retry.
